title: The header checkbox ticks only the rows loaded so far
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create 35 active parts for this test whose part numbers start with the same text, so one search lists all 35.
  • Use a browser window no more than 1080 pixels tall, so the 30 rows the list loads first do not all fit on screen.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box.
  2. Do not scroll the list.
  3. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  4. Click Deactivate parts.
  5. Click the checkbox in the header row.
  6. Click the checkbox in the header row again.
  7. Click the checkbox in the header row once more.
  8. Scroll the list to the bottom until no more rows load.
  9. Click the X at the right end of the dark bar.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The 35 parts are listed (30 loaded until you scroll).

Step 2:

  • The list stays at its first rows.

Step 3:

  • The menu opens.

Step 4:

  • Bulk mode turns on.

Step 5:

  • The bar reads 30 selected: the list loads 30 parts at a time, so only the 30 rows loaded so far are ticked.
  • The line under the table reads "30 records selected."

Step 6:

  • The bar reads 0 selected and no row is ticked.

Step 7:

  • The bar reads 30 selected again.

Step 8:

  • The other 5 parts load (35 rows in all) and are not ticked.
  • The bar still reads 30 selected, exactly the number of ticked rows (35 loaded − 5 unticked = 30).

Step 9:

  • Bulk mode ends and no part changed status: all 35 are still on the Active tab.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk)

  • S2-R6: “The checkbox in the header ticks or clears every row loaded in the list. The list loads 30 parts at a time as the user scrolls, so it ticks only the rows loaded so far. The count in the bar shows exactly how many parts will change.”

From: Tech plan "Parts Lifecycle Update — Technical Implementation Plan" (7 Oct 2026, written against PRD v22; re-shared by the QA lead on 27 Oct 2026, unchanged), read 27 Oct 2026

  • §3 Technical Decisions, D24: “design boards settle what the PRD is silent on. Show "N records selected." under the table in bulk mode (boards 4.3, 4.9). Keep "New Inventory Part" visible in bulk mode (4.3, 4.8).”
